characters.hana: Hana Mizuno, 20. Chestnut shoulder-length wavy hair half-up at work. Cream/coral/warm teal wardrobe; soft pastel cardigan, pleated streetwear skirt, enamel pins, and battered card shop lanyard. Enthusiastic, warm, occasionally shy.
characters.reina: Reina Kurogane, 21. Long ink-black hair with severe side part and red underlayer, subtle silver ear cuff. Black/garnet/silver palette; cropped charcoal motorcycle jacket, fitted jersey, tailored trousers. Intense, fiercely disciplined, guarded smiles.
characters.shiori: Shiori Tsukishima, 23. Straight dark-violet bob tucked behind ear, vintage watch and occasionally thin reading glasses. Slate blue/pearl/muted violet, structured long coat, turtleneck, asymmetric skirt and boots. Gentle composure, witty reserve.
characters.yuna: Yuna Hoshino, 19. Spiky twin buns with dyed neon tips, electric cyan/raspberry/blue palette, oversized graphic jacket, mismatched patterned tights, sticker-covered deck box and lucky bracelet. Loud theatrical mischief, honest flashes of insecurity.
characters.akari: Akari Fujimoto, 22. Glossy dark hair in high angled ponytail, square glasses, indigo/mint/white palette, angular blazer, graphic mock-neck, cargo skirt, tablet and color-coded notes. Sharp, methodical, surprisingly easily flustered.
characters.camila: Camila Vega, 24. Voluminous dark curls swept over one shoulder, burgundy/gold/black palette, long wine-colored coat, fitted vest, tailored trousers, ringed hands and gold card-case chain. Elegant, teasing, privately empathetic.
characters.marina: Marina Aoki, 21. Soft blue-black side braid and shell-shaped clip, seafoam/navy/sand palette, lightweight linen jacket, navy casualwear, canvas bag. River lover, reflective, gentle and increasingly brave.
characters.kaede: Kaede Arashi, 22. Messy silver-gray shag haircut with dark roots, acid green/charcoal/violet palette, cropped leather jacket, asymmetric tee, utility belt, combat boots and safety-pin charms. Punk bravado over cautious warmth.
